h1: Custom Scrub Shirts for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom scrub shirts for your team. Perfect for healthcare uniforms. Fast turnaround & free setup at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom scrub shirts are a practical choice for healthcare teams, clinics, and medical offices that need durable, professional uniforms. Unlike standard scrub tops, our scrub shirts are available in performance fabrics that resist wrinkles and stains, keeping your staff looking polished through long shifts. Add your logo or department name with embroidery or screen printing for a cohesive, branded look that patients recognize.
